subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept stricter Signal group requireMention behavior for existing native-only groups that have bot identity configured but no text mention detector?
rationale: The code fix is well scoped, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for an existing Signal group configuration path, so maintainers need to choose whether that compatibility change is acceptable now.

options.title: Accept stricter native gating
options.body: Merge this PR after maintainer acknowledgement that native Signal mention metadata should enforce requireMention for identity-configured groups.

options.title: Add transition path
options.body: Require a compatibility note, migration, or opt-in strict mode before changing existing native-only group behavior.

options.title: Pause Signal mention stack
options.body: Pause or close this PR if native metadata gating needs broader product reconsideration before dependent context PRs land.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter native gating
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after maintainer acknowledgement that native Signal mention metadata should enforce requireMention for identity-configured groups.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to the shared mention-gating policy and the compatibility decision this PR changes.
